domain: Christian Theology Study and Devotional Platform

theme_and_archetype.theme: Dark Base with Contemplative Light Surfaces
theme_and_archetype.description: Minimalist, sober, and contemplative. Using Navy Blue (#001F3F) as the foundational brand and structural color, highlighted with Gold/Sepia (#D4AF37, #C5A059) for premium biblical aesthetics. The UI should evoke reverence, focus, and spiritual depth, avoiding generic corporate looks.

fonts.usage: Headings (H1, H2, H3), Devotional Titles, Bible Verses, Stylized Quotes. It gives a literary and scriptural feel.
UI text, Body copy, Labels, Navigation, Buttons, Notes. It provides clean, unpretentious readability.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-none font-serif font-medium
hierarchy.verse: text-2xl leading-relaxed font-serif italic text-gold/90 text-center
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs tracking-[0.15em] uppercase font-sans font-semibold text-gold/70

colors.description: Navy Blue canvas with Sepia/Gold glowing accents. Forms a premium, religious reading environment.

layout_and_spacing.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-navy flex flex-col relative pb-20 (to account for bottom nav)
layout_and_spacing.cards: bg-navy-light/50 border border-gold/10 rounded-xl p-5 backdrop-blur-sm
layout_and_spacing.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 bg-navy/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-gold/20 flex justify-around items-center max-w-md mx-auto z-50
layout_and_spacing.reading_mode: For Bible and Text content: bg-sepia text-navy rounded-t-3xl p-6 shadow-inner

BottomNavigation.style: Glassmorphism navigation. Icons should be minimal (Lucide). Active state gets a gold tint and subtle glow. Inactive state is muted blue/grey.

DevotionalCard.style: Hero element on 'Início'. Should use a dark overlay over a contemplative background image, with a glowing gold title, highly styled serif verse in the center, and a clean reading button.

AcademyCourseCard.style: Bento or vertical list style. Use a thumbnail, title, and a golden progress bar. Eixos (categories) can be horizontal scrolling pills.

BibleReader.style: Must toggle into a 'Parchment Mode' (Light background, deep navy text) for fluid reading. Serif font for verses. Selecting a verse should trigger a subtle slide-up modal (Drawer) for 'Explicar com IA'.

PrayerWall.style: Feed style. Cards for prayer requests. 'Vou Orar' (I will pray) button is a subtle toggle (Ghost to Solid Gold) to avoid gamifying prayer but providing support.

AITutorChat.style: Chat UI within Academy. The tutor message bubbles should be soft navy/gold border. User bubbles subtle sepia.

AuthFlow.style: Full screen Navy background. Centered elegant logo. Input fields are transparent with gold bottom border or subtle solid dark blue with gold focus ring. 'Start 7-Day Trial' prominent CTA.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Not heavily used due to mobile-first nature, but buttons should scale down slightly on active (press) state: active:scale-95.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Fade in with a slight upward translation (translate-y-4 to translate-y-0 opacity-0 to opacity-100).
motion_and_interactions.modals: Use Shadcn Drawer (bottom sheet) for mobile friendliness (e.g., IA Explanations, Event details).

icons.guidance: Use thin, elegant strokes to match the serif font.

image_urls.description: Selective focus photography of Holy Bible. Warm sepia lighting. Perfect for Devotional Hero overlay (needs bg-navy/60 overlay).
Opened vintage book. Good for theology course thumbnail.
White and black book page. Good for subtle overlay or article header.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute. E.g., `data-testid='tab-inicio'`, `data-testid='btn-vou-orar'`, `data-testid='course-card'`.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind using the colors provided. Make sure to map the root variables properly to handle the deep navy theme.
2. Ensure the main layout acts as a Mobile PWA frame (max-w-md, mx-auto, hide scrollbars on main wrapper).
3. Implement the bottom navigation fixed to the bottom of the max-w-md wrapper.
4. Add Lucide icons to the tabs.
5. Use Cormorant Garamond for all biblical texts and main headers to ensure the requested reverent aesthetic.
6. Build the Bible tab with an inverted reading mode (parchment background) for better long-form reading comfort.
7. When creating the 'Explicar com IA' feature, use a mobile-friendly Drawer component from Shadcn.
